# EuroBioC2025 Carpentry Workshop: Single-cell RNA-seq {.workshop}

## Workshop Description
Analyse and interpret single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) data with Bioconductor: quality control, normalisation, dimensionality reduction, clustering, cell-type annotation, and working at scale. We’ll combine short talks with hands-on exercises using reproducible RStudio Projects and the SingleCellExperiment ecosystem.

**Pre-requisites:** Familiarity with R and Bioconductor. Familiarity with bulk RNA-seq concepts is helpful but not required.  
**Instructors:** Robert Ivánek, Mireia Ramos, Kevin Rue-Albrecht

[Conference workshop page](https://eurobioc2025.bioconductor.org/pages/carpentryworkshops.html)

## Dates and Venue
**Dates:** Monday and Tuesday, 15–16 September 2025  
**Venue:** School of Medicine and Life Sciences, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF), Barcelona

## Setup Instructions
Please ensure you have the following installed:

- R (version ≥ 4.5)  
- RStudio  
- Bioconductor packages: see [Summary and Setup](https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/bioc-scrnaseq/) in the lesson.
